name: tabless
description: Just makes your day easier. Your tracker issues, today's meetings and Markdown notes in one keyboard-driven desktop window. Data stays on your disk: no account, no telemetry. Windows · macOS · Linux.

paragraphs: Tickets, calendar and notes for engineers — one native, keyboard-first window.
Website · Try it in the browser · Download · Docs

Your tickets from GitHub, Jira, GitLab and nine more trackers, your meetings and focus time, your notes — side by side in one fast desktop app. Capture anything with a hotkey, drive everything from the keyboard, and keep it all in a file on your own disk.
features: Press Ctrl+Shift+Space from anywhere and write one line. heap. works out what it is and where it belongs — in English or Russian.

Tasks and calendar share one window. Drag a task onto the day to book a focus block; the week view keeps a rail of what still needs a slot. Repeating events with this-and-following edits, all-day and past-midnight…
